verdict.rationale: Shopify's Order MCP webhooks push UCP-shaped, HMAC-signed order events (fulfillment, refunds, cancellations) with retry logic, but subscription itself is explicitly not self-serve: 'There's no self-serve subscription API today... contact your Shopify partner manager,' and the UCP profile's webhook_url field is documented as unsupported ('Shopify doesn't honor that field today'). So an AI-native user cannot programmatically subscribe/register webhook endpoints themselves. missing for 10: self-serve webhook subscription API, support for the standard UCP profile webhook_url field, independent confirmation of webhook delivery in practice.
